g.text: Every step is timed and records its status. A step whose model is missing is reported

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: as ‘unavailable’, a crashed step as ‘failed’; steps that do not depend on it still run, and

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a missing signal is never set to zero.
